'''Mining Barques''' were 80-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] long work ships manufactured by [[Trilon, Inc./Legends|Trilon, Inc.]] They carried three crew, six passengers, 3,000 [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]] (1,000 [[Cubic meter/Legends|cubic meters]]) of cargo, and 4 [[Standard month/Legends|months']] consumables. They had a class 4 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], a class 9 [[Backup hyperdrive|backup]], a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]], and the ability to achieve 400 [[Kilometer/Legends|km]][[Standard hour/Legends|h]] in atmosphere. They were equipped with automated mining equipment, a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] array designed to detect precious metals, [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]], a forward [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]], and a heavy [[Mining laser/Legends|mining laser]]. Though the laser was intended for strip mining, it could easily penetrate a small ship's hull.

==Behind the scenes==
While the text describes the vehicle as having several small "cutting blasters" or "underbelly lasers," the stats only describe a single "heavy mining laser."
